name: Scorched Ectoplasm
summary: Scorched Ectoplasm is spectral matter gathered from tortured night elf spirits in Silithus. Mux Manascrambler needs it for his work with the dead.

sections.title: A Scorched Trace
sections.body: In Silithus, the tortured spirits of druids and Sentinels yield Scorched Ectoplasm. Mux Manascrambler, a goblin engineer in Gadgetzan, seeks it alongside other forms of ectoplasm. He believes their strange energies can reach souls that remain near the living world.

faq.answer: It is spectral matter taken from the tortured night elf spirits of Silithus.

faq.q: Where does Scorched Ectoplasm come from?
faq.answer: Tortured Druids and Tortured Sentinels in Silithus yield Scorched Ectoplasm.

faq.q: Why does Mux Manascrambler want it?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler hopes to use the otherworldly energies in ectoplasm to reach souls that remain near the living world.

faq.q: What are the other kinds of ectoplasm?
faq.answer: Frozen Ectoplasm comes from highborne spirits in Winterspring, while Stable Ectoplasm comes from ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: Where can I find Mux Manascrambler?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler can be found in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize the Ectoplasmic Distiller as Mux Manascrambler's device for gathering spectral matter.
